question: (1)/(20) is what percentage of (11)/(30)? (Rounded off to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find what percent a value A is of value B, multiply the ratio of A to B by 100.

Required % = (1/20) ÷ (11/30) × 100

⇒ (1/20) × (30/11) × 100

⇒ (3/22) × 100 = 150/11 %

⇒ 13.636... % ≈ 13.64%

**∴ The correct answer is 13.64%.**
